headline: US New-Home Sales Surge to 2026 High in October Amid Builder Discounts
summary: Sales of newly built homes reached their highest level of the year in October as home builders offered aggressive discounts and low mortgages.
why: New-home sales serve as a leading economic indicator for real estate demand, residential construction activity, and broader consumer discretionary spending.

impacts.name: Real Estate
impacts.why: Higher new-home sales directly reflect increased activity in the residential housing construction sector.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
